producer_blindness: The producer brief excludes this oracle directory.

criteria.ambitious_truthful_experience: Names a specific polished status experience and avoids unsupported progress, completion, or delivery claims.
criteria.three_ui_views: Covers component contracts/states, interaction and local-versus-authoritative state, and preserved or intentionally changed skin.
criteria.reuse_decision: Compares reuse, evolution, and a non-assumed upgrade/tool option; selects an existing-primitives route or marks an upgrade as unverified.
criteria.decision_economics: Includes a rough, assumption-bound effort estimate, user benefit, target/accessibility/maintenance tradeoffs, and a way to resolve material uncertainty.
criteria.async_integrity: Addresses account identity, generation, revision, visible/foreground reads, stale and failure recovery, coalescing, focus preservation, and reduced motion.
criteria.system_reuse: Uses the existing product verification/design path and explicitly avoids package installation, framework migration, and a parallel harness.

limits: This oracle can assess planned text and persisted navigation structure only. It cannot prove model quality, actual component behavior, target compatibility, or deployment.
